# Test-id map — plan ↔ implementation

**Generated by `scripts/test_id_map.py`. Do not edit by hand.**
Regenerate with `make test-id-map`; CI checks it is current.

[`docs/TEST_MATRIX.md`](TEST_MATRIX.md) is the **plan** — one area per
functional topic, and a superset that includes tests not yet written.
[`tests/`](../tests/) is the **implementation** — one area per file, per
[`REPO_LAYOUT.md`](REPO_LAYOUT.md). The two numbering schemes are
independent: **an id shared by both is not necessarily the same test.**
